title: Counterexample (out/<id>.json, GET /api/cex/<id>)
description: A minimal path from init to a state violating one invariant. `moves` + `ticks` is the whole path: replay applies, for k = 0..ticks, every move with tick_index == k in order, then TICK if k < ticks. `trace` is the full expanded path with a snapshot per step.

violation_duration_ms.description: For bounded invariants: t_ms - snapshot[timer_key] at the violating (last) step. null otherwise.

minimal.description: True when found by BFS: no shorter path (in moves) violates this invariant.

depth.description: Number of moves on the path = len(trace) - 1.

states_explored.description: Distinct states discovered when this counterexample was found.

wall_s.description: Not deterministic; excluded from determinism comparisons.

trace.description: trace[0] is init (move null). trace[i].move produced trace[i].snapshot. The last step violates the invariant.

moves.description: Only the injected moves, in path order, with their tick index. This is what replay and regression tests consume.

ticks.description: Number of TICK moves on the path. violated_at_ms == ticks * TICK_MS.

explanation.description: Optional human summary (root pattern). Never required for replay.
